It's a bit shorter than your average spear, perhaps to facilitate use in tight spaces.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 15 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Spear+}} Guardian Spears+ are [[Weapon]]s use by [[Guardian Scout III|Guardian Scouts III]] inside "A Moderate Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s. The {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] has a chance to drop a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Guardian Spear+ when it is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. They are [[Guardian Spear]]s that have had their tips enlarged and strengthened. They are noted to be shorter than the average spear, which is theorized to be for use in tight spaces. Being made from [[Ancient Technology]], Guardian Spears+ will deal extra damage when they are used against Guardians. They will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, nor can they be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. However, they can float on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Guardian Spears+ belong to the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a collection of Weapons that are wielded by [[Guardian Scout]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_014" |Life = 25 |Power = 15 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.3 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 35 |BuyingPrice = 75 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Guardian Spear+ Inactive Model.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Inactive Guardian Spear+ File:AoC Guardian Spear+ Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of the Guardian Spear+ ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Technology * Ancient Weapon * Guardian Gear * Guardian Spear * Guardian Spear++ }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Ancient Weapons, Guardian Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
